title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten distinct, named destinations on campus-adjacent Newark corridors, each with a specific documented reason to stop.

cards.title: Bing’s Bakery
cards.subtitle: East Main Street corridor — 253 E Main St
cards.notes: Browse the scratch-bakery counter on East Main Street; the bakery’s official site identifies this Newark location and its baked-goods offerings.
cards.short_summary: A documented scratch bakery on the East Main Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Bing’s Bakery lists its Newark location at 253 East Main Street and describes itself as a full-line scratch bakery.
cards.access_notes: Retail bakery; check the bakery’s current hours before visiting.

cards.title: National 5 & 10
cards.subtitle: East Main Street corridor — 66 E Main St
cards.notes: Use this East Main Street stop for a practical browse; its official site places the store on Main Street, blocks from the university.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street retail stop with documented proximity to UD.
cards.evidence_claim: National 5 & 10 states that it is on Main Street in downtown Newark, just blocks from the University of Delaware.
cards.access_notes: Retail store; current seasonal hours are posted by the business.

cards.title: Bing’s Bake & Brew — On Main
cards.subtitle: East Main Street corridor — 64 E Main St
cards.notes: Pick a coffee or tea stop on East Main Street; the business lists this location beside National 5 & 10 and describes its drink menu.
cards.short_summary: Coffee, tea, and Bing’s baked goods on East Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Bing’s Bake & Brew lists its On Main location at 64 East Main Street and offers coffee, espresso, tea, and baked desserts.
cards.access_notes: Purchase required; the business posts separate hours for its On Main location.

cards.title: Captain Blue Hen Comics
cards.subtitle: East Main Street corridor — 280 E Main St, Suite 101
cards.notes: Browse comics and pop-culture items at this named East Main Street shop; use the store’s posted schedule when planning a visit.
cards.short_summary: A comic and pop-culture shop on the East Main Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Captain Blue Hen Comics lists its store at 280 East Main Street, Suite 101, and describes comics and pop-culture merchandise.
cards.source_title: Captain Blue Hen Comics — About Us
cards.access_notes: Retail shop; consult the store’s posted days and hours before visiting.

cards.title: Main Street Movies 5
cards.subtitle: East Main Street corridor — 230 E Main St
cards.notes: Check the current listings and choose a screening at this East Main Street cinema; its official site provides showtimes and upcoming titles.
cards.short_summary: A five-screen cinema with current listings on East Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Main Street Movies 5 lists its address as 230 East Main Street and provides now-playing and coming-soon film information.
cards.access_notes: Ticketed cinema; confirm a film’s rating and current showtime before going.

cards.title: Newark Bike Project
cards.subtitle: East Main Street corridor — 230 E Main St, Suite 323
cards.notes: Contact the nonprofit’s shop before heading over for bicycle help, volunteering, or community programming; it posts the current shop location online.
cards.short_summary: A bicycle-focused nonprofit shop in the East Main Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Newark Bike Project lists its shop at 230 East Main Street, Suite 323, and describes its community, education, and empowerment mission.
cards.access_notes: Check the organization’s calendar or contact page for current shop access and programming.

cards.title: Days of Knights
cards.subtitle: East Main Street corridor — 173 E Main St
cards.notes: Plan a game-focused browse at this named East Main Street shop; its official site is the place to confirm current stock, events, and access.
cards.short_summary: A named tabletop and hobby destination on East Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Days of Knights identifies its Newark store at 173 East Main Street and offers games, arts and crafts, posters, and puzzles.
cards.access_notes: Retail shop; verify current opening information with the business before visiting.

cards.title: Caffé Gelato
cards.subtitle: East Main Street corridor — 90 E Main St
cards.notes: Use this East Main Street restaurant for a meal or gelato; review the venue’s current menu and service details directly before making plans.
cards.short_summary: A named restaurant and gelato stop on East Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Caffé Gelato identifies its restaurant at 90 East Main Street in Newark and publishes food and gelato menus.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant service; purchase required and current availability should be confirmed with the venue.

cards.title: Home Grown Café
cards.subtitle: East Main Street corridor — 126 E Main St
cards.notes: Review the café’s menu before stopping along East Main Street; the business documents vegetarian and vegan food options at its Newark location.
cards.short_summary: A documented vegetarian- and vegan-friendly café on East Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Home Grown Café lists its Newark address at 126 East Main Street and describes vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free menu options.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant service; check the café’s current menu and hours before visiting.

cards.title: Newark Arts Alliance
cards.subtitle: Louviers Drive corridor — 207 Louviers Dr
cards.notes: Look for gallery exhibits, classes, or public arts programming at this nearby nonprofit; its official site posts its Newark address and operating hours.
cards.short_summary: A local arts nonprofit with exhibitions, classes, and community programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Newark Arts Alliance lists its location at 207 Louviers Drive and describes gallery exhibits, a gallery shop, classes, and arts programs.
cards.access_notes: Check current gallery hours and whether a particular class or event needs registration.
